BiblicalUsage: Shoa is a people named once, among the enemies the Lord sends against faithless Jerusalem. The Babylonians and Chaldeans come with Pekod and Shoa and Koa, desirable young men and captains and rulers on horseback, and the prophet lists them as the instruments of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names the nations He uses, even the ones we have never heard of. Shoa appears once, and I hold that one mention is enough to say judgment does not need a famous army.
